decisions.reason: Given its limited web presence and component status, A faces higher aspiration uncertainty, yet organizational slack and lack of clear shortfall favor keeping it for now.
As a flagship aligned with the firm's lower-carbon direction and with dedicated market presentation, B likely meets aspirations and is kept under slack.
C has its own page but is not a strategic focus, so it is judged more strictly, though early uncertainty and slack support keeping it.
Close to the established offer with several models and a dedicated page, D is embedded in the core business and likely kept, with moderate drop risk.
As a flagship hydrogen-capable product with a documented real-world launch, E is central to strategic aspirations and receives substantial slack, making drop very unlikely.
